interpretation: All twelve preselected test questions have zero F1 even with full attention. This subset cannot substantiate answer-quality preservation or superiority.
limitations: Open-ended relation-style questions differ from candidate-based source formatting.
Aliases and answers outside the reference string can score poorly.
These observations do not establish the cause of every wrong answer.
preservation: No test resampling, answer normalization changes, or threshold tuning after this finding.
